description: Department of Local Government - Eastern Province - Summon the Meeting to Fill the Vacancy of Chairman of the Samanthurai Pradeshiya Sabha Ampara District
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the summoning of a meeting to fill a vacancy for the Chairman position in a local authority (Sammanthurai Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including scheduling a meeting for election purposes, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
